name: Crying Broken Heart
description: Crying face with broken heart is the maximum heartbreak visual — 'I am crying and my heart is broken.'
meaning: Used to express deep heartbreak, sadness, or emotional devastation. The crying face adds 'I am crying' and the broken heart adds 'my heart is shattered.'
seoDescription: What does 😭� mean? The crying face and broken heart combo explained. Used to express deep heartbreak.

longForm.overview:
😭💔 is the maximum-heartbreak combo. The crying face (😭) reads as 'I am crying' and the broken heart (💔) adds the 'my heart is shattered' beat, together forming the visual for deep emotional devastation. On TikTok, Twitter, and iMessage 😭💔 shows up under breakups, sad news, and any context where the sender wants to mark a moment of heartbreak. The combo is more devastating than 😭 alone (which can be a general cry) and more emotional than 💔 alone (which can be a heartache mention).

The combo also doubles as a way to react when a sender wants to land as genuinely devastated without sliding into the performative drama of 💀😭 (which adds the 'dead' beat). The crying-broken-heart pairing keeps the combo emotional, which is why 😭💔 is common in break-up threads and sad-song posts. Writers should default to 😭💔 when the moment really is a heartbreak moment, and reach for 😭 or 💔 alone when the read should be lighter.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
😭💔 arrives as a stand-alone reaction, sandwiched in a sentence as a beat ('they ended it 😭💔'), or stacked under a sad photo. The combo is the go-to reaction to anything that prompts heartbreak — a breakup, a sad movie, a devastating song, a loss. It also works as the closer on a thread about heartbreak.

In family group chats 😭💔 shows up on sad updates and family grief. In friend groups it arrives when someone shares a heartbreak moment. The combo is rarely sarcastic because both emojis are unambiguously sad, which makes it a safe bet when you want to land as sincere.
longForm.whenNotToUse:
Skip 😭💔 in any context where the heartbreak-label does not fit the moment — 😭💔 under a coworker's good-news post reads as tone deaf. Avoid it in customer-facing comms where the recipient may read it as dramatic. And do not default to 😭💔 when a softer reaction (🙁, 🤍) would do the same job without the maximum-heartbreak energy.

Also avoid 😭💔 when the content is not actually sad. A 😭💔 on a regular update reads as performative, and a 😭💔 on a friend's win will land as mockery no matter how friendly you intended it. The combo is on-theme, so use it when heartbreak is the actual topic.
longForm.howToReply:
Mirror 😭💔 with another 😭💔 or with 🤍 to keep the emotional thread going, or upgrade to a longer sentence like 'I am so sorry' to land as more sincere. A single 😭 or a single 💔 also works as a softer agreement if you want to register support without the maximum-heartbreak energy.

If you receive 😭💔 on your own post, treat it as a moment of support and reply with 'thank you 😭💔' or a sentence about the moment. If the combo landed from a contact where the read feels performative, you can pull back with a softer reaction emoji like 🤍 so the message registers as caring rather than over-the-top.

faqs.question: What does 😭💔 mean?
faqs.answer: 😭💔 means the sender is fully devastated. The crying face adds 'I am crying' and the broken heart adds 'my heart is shattered,' forming the universal heartbreak visual.

faqs.question: Is 😭💔 flirty?
faqs.answer: Usually no. 😭💔 is a heartbreak reaction, not a flirtation signal. If flirtation is involved it tends to come from the surrounding message rather than the combo itself.

faqs.question: What does 😭💔 mean from a girl?
faqs.answer: From a girl or anyone else, 😭💔 means the sender is devastated. There is no gendered meaning; the combo is about the heartbreak, not who is sending it.

faqs.question: What does 😭💔 mean on TikTok?
faqs.answer: On TikTok a single 😭💔 in the comments means the viewer is devastated. Creators often count the combo as a soft metric of how strong a sad moment was.

conversationExamples.interpretation: Friend sharing a breakup. Mirror with 😭💔 or a sentence that engages with the heartbreak.
Group chat reaction to a sad moment. Mirror with 😭💔 or a quote-tweet to keep the thread moving.
Sympathetic work disappointment. Mirror with 😭💔 in a tight team chat; avoid using the combo in the wider org.
Romantic sad-music share. Mirror with 😭💔 or a sentence that engages with the song.
Family grief update. Mirror with 😭💔 or a sentence that celebrates the memory.
